This policy applies to non-commercial EV purchases and is available to eligible Shanghai residents, companies, and individuals meeting specific social insurance or tax payment criteria. The continuation of this policy underscores Shanghai's commitment to promoting EV adoption, as NEVs already account for over 60% of vehicle registrations in the city, which also hosts major EV players like Tesla and Nio.
